law_name: Law No. 9 of 1968 Issuing the Copyright Protection Law
term_of_protection: Author's life + 25 years, but not less than 50 years from first publication (Art. 20); anonymous or pseudonymous works 25 years from publication (Art. 21)
author_rights: Economic (financial utilization) rights, plus moral rights: attribution and protection against changes (Art. 9); withdrawal for serious moral reasons (Art. 43)
orphan_works: No orphan-works provision in the law text
registration_required: Yes (deposit of the work with the Copyright Protection Office within one month of publication (secondary source; unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Copyright Protection Office at the Ministry of Culture and Information, where works must be deposited
notes: Law dated 16 March 1968 (Official Gazette No. 10 of 30/3/1968). Some sources cite Law No. 7 of 1984 as the current law (or as a deposit law); unresolved. Berne since 28 Sep 1976. WCT/WPPT/TRIPS status not found.
